Put the front-end libraries inside this folder with exactly this structure (only these are used for now):

  bootstrap/bootstrap.rtl.min.css
  bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
  bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.min.css
  bootstrap-icons/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff
  bootstrap-icons/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2
  tabulator/tabulator.min.js
  tabulator/tabulator.min.css
  tabulator/tabulator_bootstrap5.min.css

The other libraries you may have (codemirror, gridstack, leaflet, muuri, vis-timeline) are not needed for now;
whenever a page needs them, put them here with the same folder names next to these.
